description: Integer-only graph-native bootstrap from mechanically observed opaque actuator affordances and topology bundles. Exact tokens and aligned integer weights are preserved for the external humanoid trial boundary; graph-side Pareto and curiosity expose at most one selected program.

rules.name: emb_open_output_null_motor_bootstrap_episode
rules.comment: A developmental episode with a mechanically observed body opens one output-null candidate container. The adapter never selects a candidate.

rules.name: emb_open_integer_pareto_frontier_for_observed_motor_topology
rules.comment: The bootstrap frontier makes novelty, topology coverage, and activation effort explicit rather than hiding a scalar reward in the adapter.

rules.name: emb_mint_singleton_prior_and_program_from_opaque_actuator
rules.comment: Every observed opaque effector becomes one no-authority exploratory candidate. Its exact token crosses unchanged into the program list.

rules.name: emb_bind_direct_topology_source_effector_identity
rules.comment: Resolve an observed mechanical relation endpoint once. Later motor synthesis joins by this graph edge instead of repeatedly testing a relation-by-effector Cartesian product.

rules.name: emb_bind_direct_topology_target_effector_identity
rules.comment: Resolve an observed mechanical relation endpoint once. Later motor synthesis joins by this graph edge instead of repeatedly testing a relation-by-effector Cartesian product.

rules.name: emb_synthesize_local_compound_from_grounded_consequence_and_topology
rules.comment: A positive local singleton consequence may extend through one observed direct effector adjacency. The graph creates an exact two-member opaque bundle with receipt, consequence, source-program and topology provenance; it never enumerates arbitrary actuator sets or issues authority.

rules.name: emb_open_goal_scoped_coordination_hypothesis_from_singleton_receipt
rules.comment: A still-active goal may spend one bounded local verification on an unknown directly adjacent interaction after a positive singleton receipt. The context records why coordination novelty outranks known singleton efficiency for this goal only.

rules.name: emb_mint_compound_prior_and_program_from_observed_topology_bundle
rules.comment: A body may mechanically publish any compatible set as a topology bundle. Composition preserves every member token and never introduces a semantic alias for the bundle.

rules.name: emb_initialize_mutable_state_on_immutable_motor_candidate
rules.comment: Candidate/program deduplication keys are observed topology only. This one-shot graph initialization supplies mutable prediction, practice and duration state without making any of it part of identity.

rules.name: emb_crystallize_positive_receipt_as_motor_shape_memory
rules.comment: A positive causal receipt crystallizes one output-null motor memory keyed by the observed body relation shape and local opaque topology. It contains no actuator handle and cannot itself confer competence on a later episode.

rules.name: emb_warm_start_local_program_from_shape_decoded_receipt_memory
rules.comment: A new body episode may warm-start only a freshly minted local opaque program. ShapeDecode must explain more target body relations than it leaves residual, and the source receipt/program/candidate remain explicit provenance. Local competence still requires a new grounded receipt.

rules.name: emb_activate_shape_matched_repeat_mission_retention_context
rules.comment: Only a newly accepted mission with the same predicate as the positive source mission may turn a ShapeDecode warm hint into a local retention-verification context. This is a goal-side Pareto preference, not a host toggle or generic warm-first rule.

rules.name: emb_open_receipt_grounded_motor_selection_epoch
rules.comment: A settled physical receipt opens its own immutable successor epoch. The epoch keeps a first-class receipt edge, so later supervisory repair can only act from the receipt that caused this current epoch, never from retained session history.

rules.name: emb_open_pending_motor_selection_epoch
rules.comment: The initialized frontier opens on a later graph pass. Receipt-triggered requests are opened by the receipt-specific epoch rule, preserving their exact causal provenance as a graph edge.

rules.name: emb_publish_initialized_motor_candidate_integer_pareto_coordinates
rules.comment: Values are graph objects attached once after mutable state exists. A later novelty update mutates this same coordinate instead of minting another ParetoValue.

rules.name: emb_select_ready_motor_program_from_pareto_frontier
rules.comment: Candidate construction is parallel; this graph rule collapses a complete non-dominated frontier to its lexicographically first opaque candidate. The ready-candidate edge is the event that makes selection admissible—no host tick or magic cadence is involved.

rules.name: emb_reopen_exact_duplicate_motor_selection
rules.comment: If resume history retained two live selections with the same candidate and program, neither is privileged. Remove both live authority edges and let the ordinary Pareto collapse produce one fresh selection from the retained frontier.

rules.name: emb_retire_older_duplicate_motor_selection
rules.comment: A resumed graph may retain selections from several receipt epochs. The highest settled epoch is the current graph decision; older selection edges remain inspectable nodes but lose live motor authority before epoch cleanup runs.

rules.name: emb_retire_unselected_duplicate_motor_selection_epoch
rules.comment: An interrupted/resumed receipt transition can retain several current epoch edges. Once a selected program names one exact epoch, the other epoch edges are historical provenance only and must not remain live alternative collapses.

rules.name: emb_reopen_unexecuted_singleton_for_goal_scoped_coordination_hypothesis
rules.comment: A receipt-grounded local interaction context can revise one still-unexecuted singleton collapse after its exact compound has a complete Pareto point. The rule never interrupts a requested physical trial and retains the normal selected-for-rehearsal motor state.

rules.name: emb_supersede_undispatched_counterfactual_after_coordination_recollapse
rules.comment: A pre-dispatch coordination re-collapse invalidates only the counterfactual for its exact old program. Physical requests remain protected by the re-collapse gate; the ordinary imagination rule can then project the replacement compound.

rules.name: emb_enact_receipt_grounded_motor_program_revision
rules.comment: Only this graph rule resolves a zero-yield supervisory residual. It enacts either the receipt-grounded breadth alternative or the receipt-grounded temporal aperture alternative, then restores the exact suspended process, policy, step, and capability. The check-in and residual remain auditable; no host bypass exists.

rules.name: emb_enact_receipt_grounded_temporal_aperture_revision
rules.comment: A temporal revision re-enacts its exact causally implicated opaque program, doubles only its graph-owned observation aperture up to the mechanical horizon, and restores the suspended supervisor continuation.

rules.name: emb_open_pending_receipt_grounded_motor_program_revision_enactment
rules.comment: Revision proposal and authority restoration are separate causal graph transitions. Opening the request materializes the immutable event that permits enactment; it is not a host retry or an automatic residual dismissal.

rules.name: emb_open_body_temporal_aperture
rules.comment: One observation aperture per BODY, opened at the neutral exponent. It is opened rather than assumed so that the value is present in the graph with its provenance attached: an absent exponent and a measured one must not read the same.

rules.name: emb_apply_body_temporal_aperture_to_program
rules.comment: The observation aperture is a body fact, so the program reads it rather than owning it. A program-level frame count is no longer authoritative anywhere: whatever set it, this rule restates it from the body's exponent and the program's own scaling hint.

rules.name: emb_assess_receipt_temporal_aperture_before_motor_revision
rules.comment: The supervisor first writes one immutable assessment of the exact settled receipt. The two revision proposals consume opposite values of this node, so they cannot race from the same pre-effect graph state.

rules.name: emb_propose_temporal_aperture_for_zero_consequence_supervisory_residual
rules.comment: A zero-yield check-in may mean that the selected action was observed too briefly rather than that its topology was wrong. From the exact newest settled receipt, the supervisor may re-enact the same opaque program at a graph-derived wider aperture. The distinct-program proposal is mutually exclusive and remains the breadth alternative.

rules.name: emb_propose_distinct_motor_program_for_zero_yield_supervisory_residual
rules.comment: A zero-yield check-in is not ignored. It waits until the currently enacted motor selection has been retired by its physical receipt, then uses the successor epoch's exact receipt to propose a distinct motor program. The proposal cannot itself resolve the residual or restore authority.

rules.name: emb_update_bootstrap_novelty_coordinate_after_grounded_receipt
rules.comment: Practice changes the untried-structure coordinate, not a hidden reward. The value remains an integer Pareto coordinate and is updated only from a settled physical receipt.

rules.name: emb_link_existing_verified_progress_energy_load_to_motor_candidate
rules.comment: EmbodiedLearningSession already owns the one shared verified progress/energy/load profile. This rule only links its exact evidence candidate back to the selected bootstrap candidate; it never manufactures a second performance profile or treats hypothesis zeros as data.

rules.name: emb_close_goal_scoped_coordination_hypothesis_on_local_receipt
rules.comment: One locally receipted compound settles the goal-scoped coordination question and releases the context; later coordination requires a new causal premise rather than an unchecked loop.

rules.name: emb_retire_settled_motor_selection_and_reopen_pareto_frontier
rules.comment: A grounded receipt increments practice exactly once, records its provenance, and releases the selected program/prior/request/counterfactual edges. The ordinary graph selection rule—not Python—then chooses the next Pareto-frontier probe.

rules.name: emb_verify_warm_started_local_program_with_new_causal_receipt
rules.comment: Warm-start evidence is a prediction, never competence. A new target-episode causal receipt closes its explicit local verification and clears the pending marker without rewriting source evidence.
